info.title: DEAM Dataset - Emotional Analysis in Music
info.subtitle: DEAM dataset - The MediaEval Database for Emotional Analysis of Music
info.description:
## MediaEval Database for Emotional Analysis in Music

### Content

DEAM dataset consists of 1802 excerpts and full songs annotated with valence and arousal values both continuously (per-second) and over the whole song. The detailed description of the dataset is given in the [Manual](http://cvml.unige.ch/databases/DEAM/manual.pdf). The metadata describing the audio excerpts (their duration, genre, folksonomy tags) is in [the metadata archive](http://cvml.unige.ch/databases/DEAM/metadata.zip).
